children: SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETES PLACEMENT OF US$800 MILLION HYBRID CAPITAL ISSUANCE
ISSUANCE ATTRACTED DEMAND IN EXCESS OF US$2.5 BILLION, REPRESENTING OVERSUBSCRIPTION OF MORE THAN THREE TIMES THE AMOUNT OFFERED
ISSUANCE TARGETED AT INTERNATIONAL INSTITUTIONAL INVESTORS
PERPETUAL SUBORDINATED HYBRID CAPITAL INSTRUMENT WILL BEAR INITIAL ANNUAL COUPON OF 8.75%
PROCEEDS WILL BE PRIMARILY USED TO REPAY THE US$733 MILLION TERM LOAN TO REFINANCE ACQUISITION OF IBERDROLA MÉXICO
WILL INCLUDE FIRST ISSUER CALL OPTION EXERCISABLE FROM SEPT 17, 2031
